newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 15 bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 15 bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Tuesday it qualified 15 bond issues for insurance slated for competitive sale today.
--Los Angeles Municipal Improvement, Calif., $15.8 million of sanitary district bonds.
--Harlan Community School District, Iowa, $2 million of GO bonds.
--Genesee Intermediate School District, Mich., $1.8 million of limited tax bonds.
--New Brighton, Minn., $1.6 million, $1.5 million and $3.4 million of GO bonds.
--Port Allegany School District, Pa., $5 million of GO bonds.
--Spotsylvania County, Va., $22.2 million GO school bonds.
--Hill County, Mont., $4.3 million of GO bonds.
--Goldsboro, N.C., $8 million and $500,000 of GO bonds.
--Santa Fe County, N.M., $10.5 million of GO bonds.
--Travis County, Texas, $2.9 million of unlimited tax bonds and $6.5 million of certificates of participation.
